wrote eval/drift/atlassian/report.json

Surveyed 3 page-viewport pairs, 5593 rendered elements, measured 2026-10-08.

  system size      29 values describe the site
  colour coverage  90.2% of the colour on the page
  spacing step     2px, explaining 99.4%
  sprawl           3.7x more distinct values than tokens
  waste            2 indistinguishable colours, 2.4% of the page

· 72 distinct colours render across the pages surveyed. 12 of them account for 90.2% of the colour on the page.
· 2 colours sit within a just-noticeable difference of a colour already in use and cannot be told apart by eye — together 2.4% of the colour on the page. The heaviest is #D7D8D7, which is 2.13 from #DDDEDD.
· Spacing follows a 2px step, which explains 99.4% of the margins, padding and gaps measured.
· 1 spacing values sit off that step, the most frequent being 1px, which is 1px from the nearest multiple.
· 14 distinct font sizes are in use across 13 steps. The sizes sit on roughly a 1.155 ratio.
· 8 of those sizes carry under 1% of the text each, which is the signature of a one-off rather than a step.
· 12 corner radii are in use, clustering into 12 steps.
· 4 distinct shadows are in use. An elevation scale usually has two or three.
